note: Lincoln County Forestry, Land & Parks campground at the north end of 34-acre Otter Lake in the Harrison Hills near Gleason. The camper sites sit back in the woods; sites 12-19 are walk-in tent sites on the shore. No motors on the lake; swim beach and day-use area at the south end, and a nature trail around the lake. --Claude
